scholarships.title: Apoyo Complementario SECIHTI-OEA 2026
scholarships.official_source: Secretaría de Ciencia, Humanidades, Tecnología e Innovación (Secihti) and Organización de los Estados Americanos (OAS)

existing.description: A complementary support awarded jointly by the OAS and Mexico's Secihti to students who already hold a Secihti National Scholarship for a full-time postgraduate programme in Mexico. The OAS contribution is a single payment of USD 1,200 for settling-in expenses in Mexico, paid in Mexican pesos at the official exchange rate on the day OAS deposits it, and the number of supports depends on OAS funds. Secihti adds its monthly support under the Secihti 2026 National Scholarship Scale plus ISSSTE medical service. The call does not establish tuition, travel or full living-cost coverage, so this is not full funding.
eligibility: Declarar en su perfil único tener la nacionalidad de alguno de los Estados Miembros de la OEA, con excepción de México.

Haber obtenido una Beca Secihti Nacional in one of the six named calls: Becas Nacionales para Estudios de Posgrado programas elegibles 2025 segundo periodo; Becas Nacionales para Estudios de Posgrado en Humanidades y Ciencias de la Conducta 2025 segundo periodo; Becas Nacionales para Estudios de Posgrado en Entidades Federativas con Mayor Rezago Social 2025 segundo periodo; Becas Nacionales para Estudios de Posgrado para Especialidades en Áreas de la Salud 2025 segundo periodo; Becas Nacionales para Estudios de Posgrado en programas que pertenezcan a las áreas de Físico-Matemáticas y Ciencias de la Tierra, Biología y Química, Ingenierías y Desarrollo Tecnológico 2025 segundo periodo; or Becas Nacionales para Estudios de Posgrado 2026, término de referencia A, programas elegibles escolarizados, primer periodo.
Ser persona becaria nacional vigente en un programa de posgrado escolarizado.

Estar admitido e inscrito en las áreas de Física, Matemáticas y Ciencias de la Tierra, Biología y Química, Ingenierías, Medicina y Ciencias de la Salud (a excepción de la formación de especialidades y subespecialidades médicas), Biotecnología y Ciencias Agropecuarias.
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants must already be current Secihti National Scholarship holders admitted and enrolled in a full-time postgraduate programme in a listed subject area, and be nationals of an OAS Member State other than Mexico.
benefits: The OAS portion is explicitly stated to be independent from the scholarship granted by Secihti.
coverage: OAS: single contribution of USD 1,200 for gastos de instalación (settling-in expenses) in Mexico, paid in Mexican pesos at the official exchange rate of the day OAS deposits to the beneficiary's bank account.
Secihti: monthly economic support according to the 'Tabulador de Becas Nacionales 2026'.
Secihti: medical service provided by ISSSTE, on registering as a beneficiary under ISSSTE rules.
requirements: The beneficiary must send the information and documentation that the OAS requests for formalisation and disbursement, on time and in full.

Under article 17-A of the Ley Federal de Procedimiento Administrativo, a failure to send that information triggers a single emailed prevención with a term of no fewer than five business days; if it is not corrected, the support may be cancelled and reassigned.
application_method: There is no public application form for new applicants: participation requires already being a current national scholarship holder selected under one of the calls listed in the eligibility section.
Secihti validates the applications of persons who were beneficiaries under the listed calls and sends the compliant list to the OAS on 28 August 2026.
The OAS Award Committee deliberates on 3 September 2026 and Secihti and the OAS notify selected students directly between 4 and 10 September 2026.
Results of the assigned applications are published on the OAS website and notified by email from both Secihti and the OAS.
Formalisation is carried out by signing the corresponding instrument between the OAS and the selected beneficiary.
Disbursement is made once the support has been formalised, following the timetable and procedure the OAS communicates by email.
existing.selection_notes: The OAS selects among the Secihti national scholarship holders using ten published criteria: being admitted and enrolled in a listed subject area; being a current national scholarship holder in a full-time postgraduate programme selected by Secihti; geographic balance by country of origin; the applicant's country Human Development Index; gender; area of study; geographic distribution of the host institution in Mexico; level of study (doctorate over master's); dual nationality and residence in Mexico; and proportion of candidates per country. The number of supports depends on the availability of OAS funds.
existing.best_fit: Non-Mexican nationals of OAS Member States who are already current holders of a Secihti National Scholarship for a full-time postgraduate programme in one of the listed STEM, health, biotechnology or agricultural sciences areas in Mexico.
existing.notes: This is NOT an award first-time applicants can enter into. The only published entry route is already holding a current Secihti National Scholarship, and the applicant's name must have been on the list Secihti sent to the OAS on 28 August 2026. As of the 2026-10-01 verification date the selection, notification and formalisation steps in the published calendar had already run (3-18 September 2026); the published process close date is 30 November 2026, so what remains open is the finalisation of the process and the documentation/disbursement steps, not fresh selection. Applicants who are not existing Secihti national scholarship holders should treat this record as not applicable to them. Tuition is not covered by anything published here, Secihti does not handle immigration procedures for the beneficiary or their economic dependents, support can be cancelled if a restriction or incompatibility is found, names of beneficiaries are published in the Secihti register, and the award can be audited during the award and for 5 years after it ends.
existing.application_period: Publicación de la convocatoria: 28 de agosto de 2026. Secihti sends the compliant list to the OAS on 28 August 2026; award committee deliberates 3 September 2026; direct notification 4-10 September 2026; formalisation 7-18 September 2026; process closes 30 November 2026.
existing.deadline_display: Fecha de cierre del proceso: 30 de noviembre de 2026

scholarships.title: Fulbright-Garcia Robles Graduate Degree Program (COMEXUS, Mexico)
scholarships.official_source: Comision Mexico-Estados Unidos para el Intercambio Educativo y Cultural (COMEXUS), with the Fulbright Program

existing.description: The COMEXUS Fulbright-Garcia Robles Graduate Degree Program funds US candidates to complete a master's or PhD degree at a qualified Mexican academic institution. COMEXUS will fund up to two academic years for a master's and up to three academic years for a PhD, with an initial academic year of funding and continuation subject to academic performance and availability of funds. Financial support comprises monthly maintenance, one round-trip international air ticket for the grantee, a Fulbright medical benefit plan, COMEXUS assistance with visa paperwork, and up to 50,000 pesos per academic year to cover tuition. Applications are accepted in all fields except medicine, veterinary medicine and dentistry.
eligibility: Be a US citizen or US national eligible to apply
Have fluent Spanish at an advanced level
Hold a minimum of a B.S. or B.A. degree
Apply to a graduate degree programme at a qualified Mexican university or academic institution
Present an admission letter prior to the grant start date
Not be studying, living or working in Mexico during the application process
Not hold a temporary or permanent resident card for Mexico
Field of study must not be medicine, veterinary medicine or dentistry
existing.eligibility_summary: US candidates with fluent Spanish and at least a B.S. or B.A., who will apply to a graduate degree programme at a Mexican university and present an admission letter before the grant start date. Applicants studying, living or working in Mexico during the application process, or holding a temporary or permanent resident card for Mexico, are not eligible. Dual citizens may compete.
benefits: Tuition support of up to 50,000 pesos per academic year
One round-trip international air ticket for the grantee
Mandatory COMEXUS-sponsored welcome orientation in Mexico City
Funding for up to 2 academic years of a master's and up to 3 academic years of a PhD, subject to performance and fund availability
coverage: Up to 50,000 pesos per academic year to cover the costs of tuition
One round-trip international air ticket for the grantee
COMEXUS assistance with the visa paperwork
Mandatory welcome orientation in Mexico City for August and September starters
requirements: Complete every required field and upload all required documents in the online application
Provide a Program Information section stating field of study, project title and an abstract or summary
Write a Statement of Grant Purpose explaining country and institution choice, programme options, academic background, language skills, community engagement and adaptation
Secure an affiliation letter from a Mexican university academic department and present an admission letter before the final grant offer
Submit a Language Self-Evaluation and a Foreign Language Evaluation completed by a qualified evaluator, with advanced Spanish required
Submit three recommendation letters from referees registered in the online system
Provide transcripts from all institutions where degrees were earned and from other institutions where 12 or more credits were taken
Obtain home institution IRB review for research involving human or animal subjects
Complete the short-answer sections on flexibility and adaptability, community engagement and impact of the Fulbright award
documents: Completed online application with all fields and uploads
Program Information: field of study, project title, abstract
Affiliation letter from the Mexican host academic department
Admission letter from the host university
Foreign Language Evaluation by a qualified evaluator
Transcripts from all degree-granting and 12-credit institutions
Home institution IRB approval where applicable
existing.english_requirement: Spanish is required at an advanced level. Applicants must submit both a Language Self-Evaluation and a Foreign Language Evaluation completed by a qualified evaluator; failure to submit these forms makes the application ineligible. Shortlisted candidates are interviewed in Spanish.
application_method: Complete the online application through the COMEXUS system, starting from the INICIA TU SOLICUD link on the programme page
Upload all required documents before the deadline
Download the convocatoria and frequently asked questions from the programme page for full terms
If shortlisted, prepare for an interview conducted in Spanish in March 2027
After selection, apply to a Mexican university and present the admission letter before the grant start date
existing.selection_notes: Applicants must explain their choice of country and institution, identify the programmes and institutions they are considering, demonstrate relevant academic background and language skills, and describe how they will engage with the host community and adapt to life in the host country. Grantees will not receive the award until admitted to a qualified programme, and deferral of the grant to a different year is not allowed.
existing.best_fit: US citizens with fluent advanced Spanish and a B.S. or B.A. who will pursue a master's or PhD at a qualified Mexican institution in a field other than medicine, veterinary medicine or dentistry.
existing.notes: funding_amount is the published tuition ceiling of up to 50,000 pesos per academic year; COMEXUS does not publish the monthly maintenance amount. Most Mexican universities will not have their own call open before the close of the Fulbright grant, so a letter of acceptance is not required at application time, but grantees do not receive the award until admitted to a qualified programme.
existing.duration: Up to 2 academic years for a master's degree and up to 3 academic years for a PhD, with the first academic year funded and continuation subject to performance and budget availability
existing.application_period: The 2026-27 cycle opened on March 31, 2026 and closes on October 6, 2026 at 5:00 PM EST. Shortlisted candidates are invited to interview in Spanish in March 2027, grantees with August or September start dates attend a mandatory orientation in Mexico City in the last week of August 2027, and the programme start follows the host institution's academic calendar.
